name: chat-message
title: Chat Message
description: Message in an AI conversation. User bubbles on the right, assistant replies with an avatar, hover actions, a typing indicator, and optional token streaming.

props.name: from
props.description: Who wrote it. User messages are a primary bubble on the right, assistant messages sit on the left with an avatar.

props.name: text
props.description: Message text. Line breaks are kept. Copy writes this text to the clipboard.

props.name: variant
props.description: Assistant style: plain text, or a soft subtle bubble.

props.name: time
props.description: Timestamp shown in a time element, next to the name for the assistant and under the bubble for the user.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Image URL for the assistant avatar. Without it a spark icon is shown.

props.name: typing
props.description: Shows three pulsing dots in place of the text, announced as typingLabel.

props.name: stream
props.description: Reveals the text token by token with a caret, like a model streaming. With reduced motion the full text shows at once.

props.name: streamSpeed
props.description: Pause between streamed tokens in ms.

props.name: actions
props.description: Shows the action row on hover and focus: copy, plus like, dislike, and regenerate for the assistant. Hidden while typing or streaming.

props.name: onFeedback / @feedback / x-on:feedback
props.description: Fires when like or dislike is toggled. Pressing the active one again sends null.

props.name: onRegenerate / @regenerate / x-on:regenerate
props.description: Fires when the regenerate button is pressed.

props.name: userLabel
props.description: Accessible name of user messages.

props.name: assistantLabel
props.description: Name shown above assistant messages and their accessible name, such as the product name.

props.name: typingLabel
props.description: Hidden status text while typing is on.

props.name: actionsLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the action group.

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the copy button.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Status announced after copying.

props.name: likeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the like button.

props.name: dislikeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the dislike button.

props.name: regenerateLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the regenerate button.

a11y: Each message is an article named by userLabel or assistantLabel. Put the messages inside an element with role="log" so new ones are announced.
The actions fade in on hover and on keyboard focus inside the message, and stay visible on touch screens. Like and dislike are toggle buttons with aria-pressed.
Copying announces copiedLabel through a status region. The typing dots are hidden and announced as typingLabel.
While streaming, screen readers get the full text at once from a hidden copy. Reduced motion skips the streaming and the pulsing.

ai.whenToUse: Conversation views of AI assistants, chatbots, and support chats, together with PromptInput.
rules: Wrap the list of messages in role="log" with an aria-label
Set assistantLabel to the assistant or product name
Use typing until the first token arrives, then show the text
Use stream only for a reveal effect, real streams can update text directly

id.description: Pesan dalam percakapan AI. Gelembung user di kanan, balasan asisten dengan avatar, aksi saat hover, indikator mengetik, dan efek streaming token opsional.

props.from: Penulis pesan. Pesan user berupa gelembung primary di kanan, pesan asisten di kiri dengan avatar.
props.text: Teks pesan. Baris baru dipertahankan. Copy menyalin teks ini ke clipboard.
props.variant: Gaya asisten: teks polos, atau gelembung halus subtle.
props.time: Waktu dalam elemen time, di samping nama untuk asisten dan di bawah gelembung untuk user.
props.avatar: URL gambar avatar asisten. Tanpa ini tampil ikon kilau.
props.typing: Menampilkan tiga titik berdenyut sebagai ganti teks, diumumkan sebagai typingLabel.
props.stream: Memunculkan teks token demi token dengan kursor, seperti model yang streaming. Dengan reduced motion teks tampil utuh sekaligus.
props.actions: Menampilkan baris aksi saat hover dan fokus: copy, plus like, dislike, dan regenerate untuk asisten. Disembunyikan saat mengetik atau streaming.
props.onFeedback / @feedback / x-on:feedback: Dipicu saat like atau dislike diubah. Menekan yang aktif sekali lagi mengirim null.
props.userLabel: Nama aksesibel pesan user. Default "You", isi misalnya "Anda".
props.assistantLabel: Nama di atas pesan asisten sekaligus nama aksesibelnya, misalnya nama produk. Default "Assistant", isi misalnya "Asisten".
props.typingLabel: Teks status tersembunyi saat typing aktif. Default "Typing", isi misalnya "Sedang mengetik".
props.actionsLabel: Nama aksesibel grup aksi. Default "Message actions", isi misalnya "Aksi pesan".
props.copyLabel: Nama aksesibel tombol copy. Default "Copy", isi misalnya "Salin".
props.copiedLabel: Status yang diumumkan setelah menyalin. Default "Copied", isi misalnya "Tersalin".
props.likeLabel: Nama aksesibel tombol like. Default "Good response", isi misalnya "Jawaban bagus".
props.dislikeLabel: Nama aksesibel tombol dislike. Default "Bad response", isi misalnya "Jawaban buruk".
props.regenerateLabel: Nama aksesibel tombol regenerate. Default "Regenerate", isi misalnya "Buat ulang".

a11y: Setiap pesan adalah article bernama userLabel atau assistantLabel. Letakkan pesan di dalam elemen role="log" agar pesan baru diumumkan.
Aksi muncul saat hover dan saat fokus keyboard di dalam pesan, serta selalu tampil di layar sentuh. Like dan dislike adalah tombol toggle dengan aria-pressed.
Menyalin mengumumkan copiedLabel lewat region status. Titik mengetik disembunyikan dan diumumkan sebagai typingLabel.
Saat streaming, pembaca layar mendapat teks utuh sekaligus dari salinan tersembunyi. Reduced motion melewati streaming dan denyut.

ai.whenToUse: Tampilan percakapan asisten AI, chatbot, dan chat dukungan, bersama PromptInput.
rules: Bungkus daftar pesan dalam role="log" dengan aria-label
Isi assistantLabel dengan nama asisten atau produk
Pakai typing sampai token pertama tiba, lalu tampilkan teks
Pakai stream hanya untuk efek kemunculan, stream sungguhan cukup memperbarui text
